A''' Blackguard wilder''' was a member of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] cult [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]]. He held the rank of wilder, one of the four in the organization. This Blackguard was killed at their headquarters on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by a group of adventurers working for [[Mi Fon Lu]].
